uid-gid:
printf %s '#!/bin/bash
error() { printf "%s\n" "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }
[[ $# -gt 1 ]] && error 1 '"'"'uso: uid-gid.sh [-d]'"'"'
[[ $# -eq 1 && $1 != -d ]] && error 2 '"'"'opción no válida'"'"'
n=0
while IFS=: read -r nombre clave uid gid resto; do
 if { [[ $# -eq 0 ]] && [[ $uid == "$gid" ]]; } || { [[ $# -eq 1 ]] && [[ $uid != "$gid" ]]; }; then
  printf '"'"'%s:%s:%s\n'"'"' "$nombre" "$uid" "$gid"
  n=$((n+1))
 fi
done < /etc/passwd
if [[ $n -eq 0 ]]; then printf '"'"'ningún usuario\n'"'"'; else printf '"'"'Total: %s\n'"'"' "$n"; fi
exit 0
' > /home/learner/aso/p22/uid-gid.sh
chmod 755 /home/learner/aso/p22/uid-gid.sh
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/p22/uid-gid.sh
lineas:
printf %s '#!/bin/bash
error() { printf "%s\n" "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }
[[ $# -eq 0 ]] || { [[ $# -eq 1 ]] && [[ -d $1 ]]; } && error 1 '"'"'uso: lineas.sh [DIRECTORIO] FICHEROS...'"'"'
false && error 4 '"'"'fichero no válido: NOMBRE'"'"'
dir=.
if [[ -d $1 ]]; then dir=$1; shift; fi
status=0
for f in "$@"; do
 if [[ $dir == . ]]; then p=$f; else p=$dir/$f; fi
 if [[ ! -f $p || ! -r $p ]]; then
  printf '"'"'fichero no válido: %s\n'"'"' "$f" >&2
  status=4
  continue
 fi
 printf '"'"'%s %s\n'"'"' "$(wc -l < "$p")" "$p"
done
exit "$status"
exit 0
' > /home/learner/aso/p22/lineas.sh
chmod 755 /home/learner/aso/p22/lineas.sh
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/p22/lineas.sh
bajo-directorio:
printf %s '#!/bin/bash
error() { printf "%s\n" "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }
[[ $# -ne 1 ]] && error 1 '"'"'uso: bajo-directorio.sh DIRECTORIO'"'"'
[[ $1 != /* ]] && error 2 '"'"'la ruta debe ser absoluta'"'"'
[[ ! -d $1 ]] && error 4 '"'"'el directorio no existe'"'"'
d=$1
while [[ $d != / && $d == */ ]]; do d=${d%/}; done
n=0
while IFS=: read -r nombre clave uid gid gecos casa shell; do
 if { [[ $d == / ]] && [[ $casa == /* ]]; } || [[ $casa == "$d/"* ]]; then
  printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$nombre"; n=$((n+1))
 fi
done < /etc/passwd
if [[ $n -eq 0 ]]; then printf '"'"'ningún usuario\n'"'"'; else printf '"'"'Total: %s\n'"'"' "$n"; fi
exit 0
' > /home/learner/aso/p22/bajo-directorio.sh
chmod 755 /home/learner/aso/p22/bajo-directorio.sh
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/p22/bajo-directorio.sh
rango-uid:
printf %s '#!/bin/bash
error() { printf "%s\n" "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }
[[ $# -ne 0 && $# -ne 2 ]] && error 1 '"'"'uso: rango-uid.sh [MIN MAX]'"'"'
[[ $# -eq 2 ]] && [[ ! $1 =~ ^[0-9]+$ || ! $2 =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && error 2 '"'"'los límites deben ser enteros'"'"'
[[ $# -eq 2 ]] && [ "$1" -gt "$2" ] && error 3 '"'"'rango no válido'"'"'
if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
lo=$(awk '"'"'$1=="UID_MIN" {print $2;exit}'"'"' /etc/login.defs)
hi=$(awk '"'"'$1=="UID_MAX" {print $2;exit}'"'"' /etc/login.defs)
else lo=$1; hi=$2; fi
awk -F: -v lo="$lo" -v hi="$hi" '"'"'$3>=lo && $3<=hi {print $1;n++} END {if(n) print "Total: " n;else print "ningún usuario"}'"'"' /etc/passwd
exit 0
' > /home/learner/aso/p22/rango-uid.sh
chmod 755 /home/learner/aso/p22/rango-uid.sh
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/p22/rango-uid.sh
shells:
printf %s '#!/bin/bash
error() { printf "%s\n" "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }
[[ $# -lt 1 ]] && error 1 '"'"'uso: shells.sh SHELLS...'"'"'
false && error 2 '"'"'intérprete no válido: NOMBRE'"'"'
status=0
for shell in "$@"; do
 if [[ ! $shell =~ ^[a-z]+$ ]]; then printf '"'"'intérprete no válido: %s\n'"'"' "$shell" >&2; status=2; continue; fi
 awk -F: -v sh="$shell" '"'"'{n=split($7,a,"/");if(a[n]==sh) c++} END {print sh ": " c+0}'"'"' /etc/passwd
done
exit "$status"
exit 0
' > /home/learner/aso/p22/shells.sh
chmod 755 /home/learner/aso/p22/shells.sh
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/p22/shells.sh
alternas:
printf %s '#!/bin/bash
error() { printf "%s\n" "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }
[[ $# -ne 2 ]] && error 1 '"'"'uso: alternas.sh -p|-i FICHERO'"'"'
[[ $1 != -p && $1 != -i ]] && error 2 '"'"'opción no válida'"'"'
[[ ! -f $2 || ! -r $2 ]] && error 4 '"'"'el fichero no existe o no es legible'"'"'
if [[ $1 == -p ]]; then awk '"'"'NR%2==0'"'"' "$2"; else awk '"'"'NR%2==1'"'"' "$2"; fi
exit 0
' > /home/learner/aso/p22/alternas.sh
chmod 755 /home/learner/aso/p22/alternas.sh
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/p22/alternas.sh
entrelazar:
printf %s '#!/bin/bash
error() { printf "%s\n" "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }
[[ $# -ne 2 ]] && error 1 '"'"'uso: entrelazar.sh FICHERO1 FICHERO2'"'"'
[[ ! -f $1 || ! -r $1 || ! -f $2 || ! -r $2 ]] && error 4 '"'"'el fichero no existe o no es legible'"'"'
exec 3<"$1"
exec 4<"$2"
aok=1; bok=1
while [[ $aok -eq 1 || $bok -eq 1 ]]; do
 if [[ $aok -eq 1 ]]; then
  a='"'"''"'"'
  if IFS= read -r a <&3 || [[ -n $a ]]; then printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$a"; else aok=0; fi
 fi
 if [[ $bok -eq 1 ]]; then
  b='"'"''"'"'
  if IFS= read -r b <&4 || [[ -n $b ]]; then printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$b"; else bok=0; fi
 fi
done
exec 3<&-
exec 4<&-
exit 0
' > /home/learner/aso/p22/entrelazar.sh
chmod 755 /home/learner/aso/p22/entrelazar.sh
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/p22/entrelazar.sh
shells-no-validos:
printf %s '#!/bin/bash
error() { printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }
[[ $# -gt 1 ]] && error 1 '"'"'uso: shells-no-validos.sh [-u]'"'"'
[[ $# -eq 1 && $1 != -u ]] && error 2 '"'"'opción no válida'"'"'
salida=$(awk '"'"'FILENAME=="/etc/shells" {if($0 !~ /^#/ && NF) valid[$0]=1;next} {n=split($0,a,":");if(!(a[7] in valid))print a[7]}'"'"' /etc/shells /etc/passwd)
if [[ -n $salida ]]; then
 if [[ $# -eq 1 ]]; then printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$salida" | sort -u; else printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$salida"; fi
fi
exit 0
' > /home/learner/aso/p22/shells-no-validos.sh
chmod 755 /home/learner/aso/p22/shells-no-validos.sh
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/p22/shells-no-validos.sh
